asr.full_text: Hey guys! Seleno here, and welcome back to Play To Earn. Polygon is still going strong as one of the largest networks for gaming, and these 5 are currently leading the charge with real players, recent updates, and working gameplay right now. Here's the top 5 Polygon games for April 2026. Number 5. Meta Space is a space-themed Action RPG on Polygon, currently in beta and playable on mobile, PC, and VR. The game drops players into the role of a metanoid, exploring a sci-fi Universe across 2 primary Modes. Story Mode runs through narrative-driven missions that unlock new stages as players progress. While Arena Mode pits players head to head in competitive PvP with a matchmaking rating that tracks performance over time. Five named commanders make up the playable roster, including Todd, Zoe, Saito, Astro Black, and Dale. Combat draws from Assault Rifles, LMGs, snipers, launchers, and melee gear. The studio has also hosted esports tournaments across Indian cities and ran an in-game scavenger hunt where finding hidden mystery boxes unlocked real-world prizes. Metaspace runs a dual-token economy built around Lorde and MLD. Lorde acts as the primary in-game currency for consumables like ammunition and fuel, while MLD sits in the premium layer for acquiring high-value NFTs such as characters, weapons, and upgrades. All NFTs fall into common, rare, epic, and legendary tiers, and players trade them peer to peer. A hash rate system also lets players commit NFTs into a shared pool to accumulate MLD. On January 11th, 2026, Metaspace activated its NFT Commitment system, letting common and rare holders lock assets into the Hashrate pool to accumulate MLD. Up next, a farming MMO that's been quietly growing for years on Polygon. Number 4. Sunflowerland is a browser-based farming MMO built primarily on Polygon, with assets bridging to Base and Ronin. Players start by planting and harvesting crops for Coins, then unlock more complex Systems overtime, from fishing and animal husbandry to flower crossbreeding for Honey, Oil Extraction, Obsidian Gathering, and Potion Crafting at the Potion House. The world rotates through 7-day In-Game Seasons, each bringing new crops, fish, and weather events like Bloodmoons, Locust Plaguesagues, and tsunamis that force players to adapt. Land expansion opens up new island regions including a volcano island, and bumpkin characters level up through cooking and feeding . Chapter 11 added full co-op farming, letting players visit friends' farms to build monuments together, cook meals, and grow giant fruits. The economy revolves around four asset classes. The flower token is the primary currency for premium actions, marketplace trades, and in-game auctions. Farm collectibles are supply-limited cosmetics and boosters that players craft through gameplay and trade through the in-game marketplace. Bumkin wearables are outfit pieces for the bumpkin character, and bud NFTs apply buffs to the farm. All assets are stored on Polygon and can be deposited or withdrawn through the Wallet menu. On April 8, 2026, Sunflowerland announced a new chapter launching May 4, bringing more Mutants, Collectibles, and Resources. But the next one is different. It lets you build the game itself. Liking this list so far? Don't forget to leave a like and subscribe to our channel so you're always updated with the hottest Play2Earn games. And if you want the latest news about blockchain gaming delivered straight to your inbox, don't forget to subscribe to our newsletter as well. And now, let's get straight back to the list. Number three. The Sandbox is a Voxel-based virtual world on Ethereum and Polygon, playable on browser, Windows, and macOS. In the Sandbox, players explore, build, and interact inside a community-driven Voxel world. At the core are experiences — 3D games built by users or brand partners on parcels of digital land called LAND. Anyone can create their own using two free desktop tools. VoxEdit for designing voxel assets and GameMaker for assembling them into playable experiences. Gameplay varies widely based on community output. From metroidvania exploration to tycoon management and arcade shooters. To help gamers access gameplay videos and more gameplay-oriented, the game was designed to allow players to add their own gameplay to their mobile games. Through platform access. It was possible to use a simple platform for a short period of time within a few clicks. The economy centers on three asset types – sand, land, and assets. Sand is the platform's utility token, used for marketplace transactions, acquiring land parcels, and buying creator-made items. Land parcels are NFTs representing plots of digital real estate, combinable into larger estates. Assets are individual Voxel items like characters, props, and equipment, minted as NFTs and listed on the marketplace. The marketplace runs on Polygon, with a built-in bridge for moving SAND between Ethereum and Polygon. On March 26, 2026, the Sandbox launched a playtest for the Sandbox Next, a standalone mobile battle royale with third-person PvP, two curated maps, and up to 20 players per match. Coming up, one of the oldest names in crypto gaming still running strong. with 3rd person PVP, 2 Curated Maps, and up to 20 players per match Coming up, one of the oldest names in Crypto Gaming, still running strong Number 2 Rollercoin is a Browser-based Crypto Mining Simulator Distributed across Polygon, Bitcoin, Ethereum, BSC, and Solana Playable on any browser and on Android The core loop centers on accumulating virtual mining hash power, measured in gigahashes, per second. Players fill their mining room with miners on racks, then play a rotating set of 10 plus skill-based minigames to boost their hash power. Every 10 minutes, the platform distributes a fixed-block payout of each supported cryptocurrency across all active miners. A PC-level system governs how long that power persists, extending up to seven days at level 4. Miners also need battery power to keep running. Layered on top is the hamster system, where collectible Companions with their own stats and rarity tiers get deployed on expeditions for loot. The economy runs on two currencies. Roller token, or RLT, a capped supply token used to acquire miners, racks, batteries, and upgrades and roller season token, which resets at the close of each season. Miners and select equipment are tradable as NFTs on the marketplace, alongside hamsters and parts. The forge lets players craft new items and upgrade or merge existing miners through recipe-based queues, while lootboxes use a multi-drop mechanic so a single box can yield several items. On March 13, 2026, Rollercoin's Dev Diaries Vol. 17 detailed a lootbox overhaul with multi-drop mechanics, a new bonus power feature, and an expanded achievement system. Closing out our list is a dark fantasy auto-battler with a live tournament scene, and number one. Olderfall is a dark fantasy auto-battler spanning Moonbeam, Polygon, Arbitrum, and Scale. Playable on Android and through any web browser. In Olderfall, players take on the role of a gladiator-master commanding warriors called Fallen in arena combat. Characters aren't controlled manually mid-fight. The game emphasizes pre-battle strategy — team composition, character progression, and loadout decisions made before each match. Players recruit procedurally generated Fallen, each with unique stats and fighting styles—and equip them with weapons, armor, and gear. Combat Modes span daily PvP deathmatches for character leveling, PvE encounters, and competitive tournaments hosted on N3muss with on-chain leaderboards. The Seasonal Structure adds faction-based content through groups like the Hollow Court and the Verdant Kin, with cosmetics and progression boosters available through a paid battle pass. The asset ecosystem centers on fallen characters, acquired as on-chain NFTs with millions of possible trade combinations. Players also collect weapons, armor, and pets as separate on-chain assets, all tradable through the game's marketplace. A seasonal Battle Pass delivers additional NFT cosmetics, weapon and armor chests, and the in-game currency vitrium. The upcoming utility token is planned to power tournament entry, crafting, and other in-game functions. On April 1, 2026, Olderfall launched Season 4 Reforge and Conquer, bringing new faction–exclusive weapons, advanced forage mechanics like Burn and Merge, and Guild Leaderboards as a new competitive layer. If you want to stay ahead in the world of play-to-earn gaming, don't forget to follow us on X and join our Discord community, where thousands of gamers are discussing the latest play-to-earn titles, sharing strategies, and finding the best opportunities to earn while playing. Click the link, jump in, and start connecting with fellow gamers today! And for even more info on everything about blockchain games, check out our website at PlayToEarn.com, where we have the largest database of games that have all the info you need. That's it for today. See you next video!
